To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the modulation response in an injection-locked laser is significantly enhanced when optical isolation is removed.

the modulation response of a laser is enhanced when the laser is injection-locked to a master laser and that this modulation enhancement can be maintained when the optical isolator between the master and slave lasers is removed.
